scope: Current checkout, local offline backend and real Edge UI; rebuilds included. Existing user changes preserved; no real model or IBKR calls.

fixed.problem: Malformed provider response could escape as an internal error
Cancelled local generation could leak its pending reply into a later conversation
Leading whitespace caused standalone calculator command parsing to fail
Blocked or full browser storage broke pages or rolled back successful chat state
Negative-coordinate desktop regions expanded mouse interception beyond the visible region
Malformed Origin headers triggered 500; cross-scheme origins were accepted
Malformed successful options response overwrote the existing report/chat before rendering failed
Submission silently omitted the renamed course PDF and main batch launcher; README named an old ZIP
Main package included unreviewed raw HTML cache and failed its credential scanner; raw cache is now excluded while the reviewed runtime JSON remains included
Manual source provenance had drifted from the shipped files; instructions were rechecked and reviewed hashes refreshed

remaining_limits: No mathematical guarantee of zero bugs; no guarantee of financial answer correctness.
Real DeepSeek connectivity, real IBKR permissions/data and real local-model inference were not rerun during this audit.
Native physical drag, tray, microphone/audio and multi-monitor behavior require manual hardware testing.
README team member names, student IDs and responsibilities still require real team information.
Existing older ZIPs and acceptance reports are historical; use the rebuilt main v17 submission and its new package check.
package_verification: See dist/package_check_v17.json after the main v17 package is rebuilt and independently extracted.
